clips.send: A husband sends it to his wife: anxiety their unfiltered water is draining his hormones.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the chemicals sitting in ordinary tap water are part of what's quietly draining your human growth hormone and your testosterone - the same water most of us drink straight from the faucet every day.

His own fix is a whole-house filtration system: water runs through a pre-filter, then granular activated charcoal, then a second filter and a UV light before it ever reaches a shower or a glass. He's clear he isn't selling it - he just trusts the person who built his.

You don't need his exact setup. You need to ask your own filter, or your water company, one question: what does this actually take out?

What's really coming out of your tap?

#kevintrudeau #tapwater #waterfilter #hormonehealth #cleanwater #healthtips
